description: This file defines the singleton class 'SugarSprites' responsible for managing sprite metadata within the SuiteCRM project. It provides methods to load sprite metadata, cache it, and ensure a single instance of the class is used throughout the application.

classes.name: SugarSprites
classes.description: A singleton class to load and manage sprite metadata, providing facilities to load sprite information from cache files and ensure only one instance exists.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SugarSprites, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: loadSpriteMeta
methods.description: Loads sprite metadata for a given directory if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadMetaHelper
methods.description: Helper method that includes the sprite metadata PHP file and loads the sprite array into the class instance.
